answer: Lease 1 GB of encrypted random data on an independent archive for 30 days, with grove/ripple/inlet embedded in the initial nonce. Every six hours the registry requests an unpredictable Merkle proof; it consumes one storage-node/lease ID and suspends keys that miss a proof or reuse an ID. Proposed archival fee is .45 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .45 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,450 (1,000 × .45). Limitation: providers could collude or pool storage secretly.
